name: nullGuard
description: WireGuard VPN management application for creating and managing VPN servers and clients. For the full documentation of this project, please visit: https://github.com/nullata/nullGuard/

ports.name: WireGuard UDP Port
ports.description: WireGuard server UDP port. Add additional UDP port mappings for each extra WireGuard server instance.

variables.name: SERVER_PORT
variables.description: Container-side port the web UI listens on. Must match the WebUI Port Target value above.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your UTC TZ offset. List of available TZs: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones

variables.name: DB_HOST
variables.description: Your MariaDB/MySQL database host or container name

variables.name: DB_PORT
variables.description: MariaDB/MySQL database port

variables.name: DB_USER
variables.description: The designated user for this application in the database. For more info on the requirements, please visit: https://github.com/nullata/nullGuard/blob/main/README.md#database-setup

variables.name: DB_PASS
variables.description: Your MariaDB/MySQL database user password.

variables.name: DB_NAME
variables.description: Your MariaDB/MySQL database name. For more info on the requirements, please visit: https://github.com/nullata/nullGuard/blob/main/README.md#database-setup

variables.name: DB_TYPE
variables.description: Database backend: mysql (default) or sqlite. To use sqlite: set this to 'sqlite', then manually add a Path mapping (e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/nullguard/data) to /data inside the container so the database file persists across updates.

variables.name: SERVER_SSL_ENABLED
variables.description: Enable SSL for the web UI. Default: false.

variables.name: SESSION_SECRET_KEY
variables.description: Secret key for session encryption. Auto-generated if not set, but highly recommended to set a random value to prevent all users being logged out on container update.

variables.name: SESSION_MAX_AGE
variables.description: Maximum session age in seconds. Default: 3600.

variables.name: COOKIE_SECURE
variables.description: Set secure flag on cookies. Enable when using SSL. Default: false.

variables.name: ENV
variables.description: Environment mode. Set to production for secure session cookies. Default: production.

variables.name: WG_SERVER_DEFAULT_NAME
variables.description: Default interface name for new WireGuard servers.

variables.name: WG_SERVER_DEFAULT_COMMENT
variables.description: Default comment for new WireGuard servers.

variables.name: WG_SERVER_DEFAULT_ADDR
variables.description: Default address in CIDR notation for new WireGuard servers.

variables.name: WG_SERVER_DEFAULT_PORT
variables.description: Default WireGuard listen port for new servers.

variables.name: WG_SERVER_DEFAULT_SUPERNET
variables.description: Default supernet CIDRs for new servers.

variables.name: WG_SERVER_DEFAULT_KEEPALIVE
variables.description: Default client keepalive in seconds (0-600) for new servers.

variables.name: WG_SERVER_DEFAULT_CONF_PATH
variables.description: Default config file path for new WireGuard servers.

variables.name: WG_SERVER_CONF_PATH
variables.description: Path inside the container where WireGuard server configs are generated. Not mandatory to persist via volume - server configurations are stored in the database and regenerated from there on startup.

variables.name: WG_CLIENT_DEFAULT_NAME
variables.description: Default name for new WireGuard clients.

variables.name: AUTO_START_SERVERS
variables.description: Automatically start all WireGuard servers on application startup. Default: false.
